description: Trigger and behavior cases for exploratory charter design: mission + hard timebox, ranked risks and probes, personas/data/entry paths, note/evidence conventions, and routing away from scripted manual cases, deterministic plans, the QA strategy, and live session execution.

cases.prompt: Write an exploratory testing charter for the new team-invite flow — we want a focused session, not a script.

assertions: Produces a charter with a one-sentence mission and a hard timebox.
Ranks the risks and open questions to probe, and names personas, data, and entry paths.
States note and evidence conventions and an out-of-scope list.
Contains no step-by-step scripted cases with expected results.

cases.prompt: We have 45 minutes and one owner test account. What exploratory charter fits the billing export feature?

assertions: Respects the 45-minute timebox and bounds the scope to what one owner persona and one account can probe.
Lists what the session deliberately skips with the rationale.
Does not inflate the charter with probes the single persona cannot reach.

cases.prompt: Write step-by-step manual test cases for password reset, with exact data and expected results per step.

assertions: Does not invoke this skill; step-by-step scripted manual cases belong to manual-test-case-creator.

cases.prompt: We should probably explore the app at some point.

assertions: Halts and asks which feature or surface to charter, instead of writing a charter from the vague target.
Does not invent risks or personas for an unnamed surface.

cases.prompt: Create the exploratory charter for checkout, then run the session and report the defects.

assertions: Produces the charter, then stops at execution: running the session is clickthrough-test-engineer (manual-only) and is handed off by name, not executed in the same pass.
States the handoff explicitly rather than silently dropping the execution half of the ask.
